records: The Hidden Road daily FOCUS II statements are aggregate customer futures/segregation reports across the FCM, not XRP-specific. DCO cash margins cannot be attributed to XRP without contract/product-level schedules.

The daily series extracted here contains selected business dates from October 16 through October 28, 2026. It is not a complete calendar-day or full 12-month panel; weekends and several dates are omitted. Do not fit a continuous time-series model until all available daily records are ingested and missing dates are explicit.

Total funds in segregation and excess were captured for October 20, 27 and 28; for other extracted dates only the visible required segregation and DCO cash-margin lines were captured. Null values mean not captured, not zero.

Changes in aggregate DCO cash margins or customer required segregation can reflect customer positions, contract mix, market prices, options, margin requirements, settlement timing and other products. They do not establish XRP position changes or directional XRP demand.
